specification.objective: Supersedes profile-tab-focus-rendering-v2: preserve existing focus behavior while loading genuine Poppins fixtures only in tests and correcting evidence traceability.

requirements.statement: Load unchanged genuine Poppins fixture bytes only in native tests; exclude test fixtures from production assets.
Characterize rendered focus borders and geometry across selected and unselected tabs, modes and viewport widths, preserving keyboard and semantics behavior.
Archive this v3 locked contract byte-identically and distinguish baseline characterization from target verification.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The baseline and target pass both admin contrast and employees suites; target verifies multiple focus border pixels, geometry, keyboard interaction and actual semantics.
Affected target employees suite uses authentic test font bytes without runtime fetch; release asset manifest excludes test fixtures.
Archived v3 lock is byte-identical; baseline characterization is not represented as exclusively target evidence.

invariants.statement: No global changes or changes to unrelated tabs, content or behavior.

forbidden_states.statement: Focus and selection are visually indistinguishable.

inputs.statement: Theme, viewport, employee and selection actions.

failure_semantics.statement: Regression fails on incorrect selected indicator.
